! Game text
| Use 3 Force. Each player counts cards in hand, then places entire hand and Used Pile onto Reserve Deck. Shuffle, cut and replace. Each player then draws from Reserve Deck the counted number of cards to create a new hand. || Use 3 Force. Each player {{Errata hl|1=places hand onto Reserve Deck (if possible),}} then places Used Pile onto Reserve {{Errata hl|1=Deck; reshuffle.}} Each player then draws {{Errata hl|1=cards}} from Reserve Deck {{Errata hl|1=equal to}} the number of cards {{Errata hl|1=just placed from hand onto Reserve Deck (if any).}} || Use 3 Force. Each player places hand onto Reserve Deck (if possible), then places Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws cards from Reserve Deck equal to the number of cards just placed from hand onto Reserve Deck (if any).
